findings.source_quote: ἐὰν γάρ, [φασί,] διὰ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν παρθένων τούτων μὴ παρενεχθῶσι διὰ τῆς πύλης, τὰς χρόας αὐτῶν ἀλλάξαι οὐ δύνανται
findings.english_quote: Retain the gate/rock relationship, shared load-bearing, condition on understanding and the tower lord’s inspection.
findings.issue: The theological metadata attributes a condition on understanding and the tower lord’s inspection to this unit. Neither occurs in the selected passage. Its explicit condition concerns the stones’ inability to change color without being carried through the gate by the virgins’ hands.
findings.suggested_revision: Remove the references to understanding and the tower lord’s inspection from this unit’s metadata. Describe the actual color-change condition alongside the rock/gate relationship and shared support. Any replacement metadata requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν ὑπὸ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιδεδομένοι, οὐδὲ διὰ τῆς πύλης παρενηνεγμένοι.
findings.english_quote: Do not replace the narrated scene with its later interpretation; preserve disputed counts and conjectural negation as explicit alternatives.
findings.issue: The metadata incorrectly says this unit preserves a conjectural negation as an explicit alternative. The supplied reports locate that disputed negation in S.9.iii.3, not S.9.iv. The selected unit’s bracketed supplements are not negations, and its notes do not present a conjectural-negative alternative.
findings.suggested_revision: Remove the conjectural-negation claim from this unit’s rationale. Retain the accurate discussion of the disputed count, editorial supplements, and longer versus shorter reason in verse 6.

findings.source_quote: οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν ὑπὸ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιδεδομένοι, οὐδὲ διὰ τῆς πύλης παρενηνεγμένοι.
findings.english_quote: The virgins had not handed them over or carried them through the gate.
findings.issue: The simplified sentence makes the virgins the explicit agent of both negated actions. The selected source separately denies that the stones had been brought through the gate, without restricting that denial to carriage by the virgins. The English therefore permits a possibility the source excludes: passage through the gate by someone else. The standard edition preserves this separate negation, but the simplified main text does not.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction: “They had not been handed over by the virgins, and they had not been brought through the gate.” This replacement requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: ἐὰν γάρ, [φασί,] διὰ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν παρθένων τούτων μὴ παρενεχθῶσι διὰ τῆς πύλης, τὰς χρόας αὐτῶν ἀλλάξαι οὐ δύνανται
findings.english_quote: Retain the gate/rock relationship, shared load-bearing, condition on understanding and the tower lord’s inspection.
findings.issue: Independently checked against the selected source, this edition’s theological metadata introduces understanding and the tower lord’s inspection, neither of which occurs here. The stated necessity concerns the stones’ color change and carriage through the gate by the virgins’ hands.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace the out-of-unit references with a description of the actual color-change condition. Keep the rock/gate relationship and shared support. Review the replacement before accepting it.

findings.source_quote: οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν ὑπὸ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιδεδομένοι, οὐδὲ διὰ τῆς πύλης παρενηνεγμένοι.
findings.english_quote: Retain rock/gate distinctions, shared carrying, stone counts, the explicitly conjectural negative and the distinction between a pause and completion; preserve all substantive alternative notes.
findings.issue: The simplification metadata claims preservation of an explicitly conjectural negative that belongs to S.9.iii.3, not this selected unit. The theological rationale repeats the same out-of-unit claim. This inaccurately describes both the source choices and the work performed in this edition.
findings.suggested_revision: Remove the conjectural-negative claim from both metadata blocks. Describe the actual preserved distinctions and disclosed alternatives in S.9.iv, including the separate gate negation after it is corrected.

summary: Both editions require revision. The standard main text covers the selected working source without an identified substantive translation defect, but its metadata imports claims from neighboring units. The simplified edition additionally weakens the separate denial that the stones passed through the gate. The notes distinguish editorial supplements and disclose the stated alternatives without requiring replacement of the working readings. This review evaluates the supplied source and attributed reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation. Proposed corrections remain subject to fresh review.
